data.name: Spice_GuideLinux
data.value: Linux: install virt-viewer with your distribution's package manager. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install virt-viewer · Fedora: sudo dnf install virt-viewer. The remote-viewer command must be on PATH.

data.name: Spice_GuideMac
data.value: macOS: install with Homebrew (brew install virt-viewer), or put RemoteViewer.app in /Applications and it will be used. Press [Search again] after installing.

data.name: Spice_GuideAndroid
data.value: Android: install a SPICE app (for example aSPICE or Opaque). When you open a console, the connection file (.vv) is handed to that app. Search the app store for 'SPICE' to find one.
